typography.strategy: Classic broadsheet headlines paired with clean sans-serif body text. Generous line height on body. Tight tracking on large headings.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalistic. Use sharp 1px borders rather than soft shadows to replicate the printed broadsheet feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: Heavy use of horizontal rules (1px and 2px borders) to separate articles and sections, mimicking newspaper columns.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle paper grain noise on the off-white background to enhance the broadsheet aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). Newspapers are rectangular and structured.

layouts.grid_system: Multi-column layout mimicking broadsheet. Use responsive Tailwind grid (12 columns). Generous spacing.

home_page.masthead: Centered, large Playfair Display font, dynamic date underneath, separating double border lines.
home_page.breaking_ticker: Horizontal scrolling text just below the masthead.
home_page.hero_section: Lead global story spans 8 columns. 2x2 grid of thumbnails spans 4 columns.
home_page.main_content: Left thumbnail, right content layout for feed. 8 columns.
home_page.sidebar: Sticky right sidebar. 4 columns. Contains search, tabs, ads, newsletter, weather.

component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp edges, solid accent colors, hover states that increase contrast.
component_guidelines.cards: Cardless design. Use pure grid layouts with solid border dividers.
component_guidelines.tags: Small, uppercase, tracking-widest, bold text in primary accent color (Deep Navy/Dark Crimson).
component_guidelines.nav_bar: Sticky, solid background (or glassmorphism but strictly non-transparent) to ensure readability. Contains Dark Mode toggle.

motion.hover_states: Underline animations on article titles. Image slight scale on hover.

accessibility.contrast: APCA/WCAG AA compliant. High contrast between text and background.
accessibility.data_testid: Mandatory on all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs).
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (2px solid primary accent) for keyboard navigation.

general: No cryptocurrency, stock tickers, or tokens allowed.
Use Playfair Display for all headlines and Inter for all body text.
Use Phosphor Icons or lucide-react for clean, classic iconography.
Implement persistent dark mode toggle in the sticky header.
Ensure the Emergency alert banner is distinct (crimson/amber) and placed above the masthead.
Build a metered paywall with blur overlay and subscription modal.
For the admin dashboard, create an RBAC system (Administrator/Editor/Reporter), comments moderation, push notification console, audit logs, GST invoicing.
universal_guidelines: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use data-testid for all interactive and key informational elements.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
Prioritize existing shadcn/ui components before creating new ones.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, while keeping card borders strict as per the broadsheet look.
